subtitle: Preview every change before it touches your files.
name: Name
title: Title
onlyChecked: Only checked rows are changed. All selected items are validated before renaming. Files are staged to temporary names first, so safe swaps are supported.
safetyTip: Tip: select the folder you want to process, configure one or more steps, then review every green preview before applying.
selectItemsToRename: Select at least one file or folder to rename.
regexMatchTip: Regular expression to match in the filename. Leave blank to skip this step.
regexReplaceTip: Replacement text for regex matches. Use $1, $2, etc. for captured groups; leave blank to remove matches.
regexIgnoreCaseTip: Match the regular expression without distinguishing uppercase and lowercase.
regexExtensionTip: Apply the regular expression to the full filename, including its extension.
nameModeTip: Keep the name, replace it with a fixed value, or add the name value as a prefix or suffix.
caseModeTip: Keep the name's case or convert it to uppercase, lowercase or title case.
nameValueTip: Text used by the Fixed, Prefix or Suffix name mode.
extensionModeTip: Keep, change case, replace, append to or remove the file extension.
extensionTextTip: Extension text used by Fixed or Extra mode. A leading dot is optional.
replaceFindTip: Text to find in the name. Use * to match any sequence of characters.
replaceWithTip: Text to replace matches with. Leave blank to remove matches.
replaceMatchCaseTip: Require matching uppercase and lowercase when finding text.
replaceFirstTip: Replace only the first matching occurrence.
prefixTip: Text to add at the beginning of the name.
insertTip: Text to insert at the specified position in the name.
insertPositionTip: Zero-based insertion position: 0 means the beginning. Positions beyond the name insert at the end.
suffixTip: Text to add at the end of the name, before the extension.
numberModeTip: Add a sequence number as a prefix, suffix, both, or at an insertion position. None disables numbering.
numberAtTip: Zero-based position for Insert numbering mode. Positions beyond the name insert at the end.
numberStartTip: First value in the numbering sequence.
numberIncrementTip: Amount added for each selected item. Negative values count down.
numberPaddingTip: Minimum number width, padded with leading zeros where supported.
numberSeparatorTip: Text between the number and the name.
numberBreakTip: Restart the sequence after this many selected items. 0 means no restart.
numberFolderTip: Restart numbering when the selected item's parent folder changes.
numberTypeTip: Number representation, such as decimal, binary, hexadecimal, Roman or alphabetic.
numberCaseTip: Keep the formatted number's case or convert its letters to lowercase or uppercase.
folderModeTip: Add parent folder names as a prefix or suffix. None disables this step.
folderSeparatorTip: Text between folder names and between the folder text and the filename.
folderLevelsTip: Number of parent folder levels to include, ordered from outermost to innermost.
removeFirstTip: Remove this many characters from the beginning of the name.
removeLastTip: Remove this many characters from the end of the name, before the extension.
removeFromTip: First character position in the removal range (1-based; 0 also starts at the first character).
removeToTip: Last character position in the removal range, inclusive. 0 disables range removal.
removeCharsTip: Remove every occurrence of each character entered here.
removeWordsTip: Remove the exact text strings listed here, separated by whitespace. Matching is case-sensitive.
cropModeTip: Before removes text before the first match; After removes text after it. The matched text is kept.
cropTextTip: Case-sensitive text to locate for cropping. Leave blank to disable cropping.
removeDigitsTip: Remove all digit characters from the name.
removeHighTip: Remove all non-ASCII characters (values above 127), including accented letters and emoji. Characters are deleted, not transliterated.
removeDoubleSpacesTip: Collapse consecutive spaces to a single space.
removeAccentsTip: Remove combining accents from letters, for example cafe with an accented e becomes cafe.
removeSymbolsTip: Remove punctuation and symbol characters from the name.
trimSpacesTip: Remove whitespace from the beginning and end of the name.
trimCharsTip: Keep only letters, removing digits, spaces, punctuation and other non-letter characters.
leadDotsTip: Remove one or all leading dots, or leave them unchanged.
dateModeTip: Add the date as a prefix or suffix, or replace the name. None disables Auto Date unless at pos. is positive.
dateAtTip: 0 uses Mode. A positive value inserts the date at that 1-based position (1 means the beginning), overriding Mode.
dateFormatTip: Choose the order of day (D), month (M), year (Y), hours (H), minutes (M in time) and seconds (S), or use Custom.
dateOffsetTip: Shift the selected date by this many days. Positive values move forward; negative values move backward.
dateCustomTip: Select Custom format and use %Y (year), %m (month), %d (day), %H (hour), %M (minute), %S (second). Example: %Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S
dateSeparatorTip: Separator between the date and the filename.
dateSegmentTip: Separator between date/time components in preset formats.
dateCenturyTip: Use a four-digit year in preset formats. Custom formats use %Y or %y.
dateTypeTip: Local file timestamps captured on folder load. Refresh to reload. Creation/access dates depend on filesystem support.
